H2981.def: produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth

H2982.deriv: from בּוּס (bûwç, H947); trodden, i.e. threshing-place;
H2982.def: Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem
outline: 1) an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'

H2983.def: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
outline: 1) descendants of the 3rd son of Canaan who lived in or around the site of Jebus, the early name for Jerusalem
1) one of the sons of David, born in Jerusalem

H2985.def: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
outline: 1) a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom
2) another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak

H2986.def: properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp)
outline: 1) to bring, lead, carry, conduct, bear along
1b3) to be brought, be led, be conducted
1) the son of Lamech by Adah and brother of Jubal; described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle

H2991.deriv: from בָּלַע (bâlaʻ, H1104) and עַם (ʻam, H5971); devouring people;
outline: 1) a city of Manasseh apparently located in the territory of either Issachar or Asher

H2992.deriv: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from יָבָם (yâbâm, H2993);
H2992.kjv: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.
outline: 1) (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
1a) the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name

H2995.deriv: from בָּנָה (bânâh, H1129) and אֵל (ʼêl, H410); built of God;
H2995.def: Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine
outline: 1) a town in Judah on the northern boundary near the sea
2) a town in Naphtali on the boundary in upper Galilee

H2997.deriv: from בָּנָה (bânâh, H1129) and יָהּ (Yâhh, H3050); built of Jah;

H2998.deriv: from בָּנָה (bânâh, H1129) and יָהּ (Yâhh, H3050); building of Jah;

H2999.deriv: probably from בָּקַק (bâqaq, H1238); pouring forth;
H2999.def: Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan
outline: 1) a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea

H3000.deriv: from בָרַךְ (bârak, H1288) and יָהּ (Yâhh, H3050); blessed of Jah;
outline: 1) father of a Zechariah, in the reign of Ahaz and time of Isaiah
